 "command": "mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-4dadee77.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate the enclosing 5-colored rectangular frame.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if 5 in grid[r]]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h))]
    if not rows or not cols:
        return out
    top, bottom, left, right = min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)
    # Color the first two inward layers of the hollow frame.
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            d = min(r - top, bottom - r, c - left, right - c)
            if d == 1:
                out[r][c] = 2
            elif d == 2:
                out[r][c] = 5
    return out
PY
